fetch_message_details.description: Look up the delivery status and details of a message you sent or received, including why it failed if it did not go through.

mock_response.body: Your appointment is confirmed for tomorrow at 2pm.

fetch_message_details.name: fetch_message_details

parameters.description: The unique ID of the message to look up (starts with SM). You get this back when you send a message.
parameters.name: message_sid

body.description: The text content of the message, or empty if the message carries only media.

date_sent.description: When Twilio sent the message, or empty if it has not been sent yet.

error_message.description: A description of what went wrong if the message failed, or empty if there was no error.

from.description: The phone number the message was sent from.

message_status.description: Where the message is in delivery, such as queued, sending, sent, delivered, undelivered, or failed.

sid.description: The unique ID of the message.

to.description: The phone number the message was sent to.

get_call.description: Look up a phone call: whether it was answered, how long it lasted, and when it started and ended.
get_call.name: get_call

parameters.description: The unique ID of the call to look up (starts with CA). You get this back when you make a call.
parameters.name: call_sid

call_status.description: Where the call is: queued, ringing, in-progress, completed (answered and ended), busy, no-answer, failed, or canceled.

duration_seconds.description: How long the call lasted, in seconds, or empty until it ends.

end_time.description: When the call ended, or empty while it's going on.

from.description: The phone number the call came from.

sid.description: The unique ID Twilio gave the call (starts with CA).

start_time.description: When the call was answered, or empty if it wasn't.

to.description: The phone number that was called.

list_calls.description: List your recent phone calls, newest first. You can narrow the results to a number called or called from.
list_calls.name: list_calls

parameters.description: Only include calls to this phone number. Leave empty to include every number.
parameters.name: to_number

parameters.description: Only include calls from this phone number. Leave empty to include every number.
parameters.name: from_number

parameters.description: How many calls to return, from 1 to 100. Defaults to 20.
parameters.name: limit

from.description: The phone number the call came from.

sid.description: The unique ID Twilio gave the call (starts with CA).

start_time.description: When the call was answered, or empty if it wasn't.

to.description: The phone number that was called.

list_messages.description: List your recent text messages, newest first. You can narrow the results to a specific recipient or sender.

messages.body: Your appointment is confirmed for tomorrow at 2pm.

list_messages.name: list_messages

parameters.description: Only include messages sent to this phone number. Leave empty to include all recipients.
parameters.name: to_number

parameters.description: Only include messages sent from this Twilio phone number. Leave empty to include all senders.
parameters.name: from_number

parameters.description: How many messages to return, from 1 to 100. Defaults to 20.

make_call.description: Call a phone number from your Twilio number and read out a message in a computer voice, then hang up.
make_call.name: make_call

parameters.description: The phone number to call, including the country code (for example, +15551234567).
parameters.name: to_number

parameters.description: Your Twilio phone number to call from, in +15551234567 format. It's the number the person sees.
parameters.name: from_number

parameters.description: What to say when the call is answered. It's read out once, so put the most important part first.
parameters.name: message

from.description: The phone number the call came from.

sid.description: The unique ID Twilio gave the call (starts with CA).

to.description: The phone number that was called.

send_sms.description: Send a text (SMS) message to a phone number from your Twilio phone number or messaging service.

parameters.description: The phone number to text, including the country code (for example, +15551234567).
parameters.name: to_number

parameters.description: Your Twilio phone number (in +15551234567 format) or a Messaging Service SID (starts with MG) to send from.
parameters.name: from_number

parameters.description: The text of the message to send.
parameters.name: body
